metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code with entry points (index.cfm, download.cfm) and a database-backed runtime deployed on a single Windows EC2 instance. Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: The application owns a persistent data store (SQL Server 2005 via datasource docportal), exposes CRUD operations on document entities (list, search, download), and manages user sessions. Classified as stateful-crud.

decomposition_strategy.current_state: APP-Q2 scored 1. Tightly-coupled monolith — 2 CFML files with inline SQL, shared session state, no separation of concerns.
decomposition_strategy.rationale: The application is only 2 files (~60 lines of code total). The runtime (ColdFusion 8), database (SQL Server 2005), and OS (Windows Server 2008) are all past EOL. There is nothing to strangle. A complete rewrite is the lowest-risk path for this minimal application.
decomposition_strategy.effort_estimate: Low to Medium — 4-8 weeks for complete rewrite including new infrastructure, CI/CD pipeline, and testing.

findings.title: Managed Compute: All compute on raw EC2 with EOL operating system
findings.description: All compute runs on a single raw EC2 instance (Windows Server 2008 with IIS 7 and ColdFusion 8). No managed container orchestration, no serverless.
findings.gap: No managed compute adoption. Workload runs on EOL operating system with no path to managed services.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the application in a modern language and deploy on ECS/Fargate or Lambda.

findings.title: Managed Databases: Self-managed SQL Server 2005 on EC2
findings.description: The database is self-managed SQL Server 2005 running on the same EC2 instance. No RDS, no Aurora, no DynamoDB.
findings.gap: Database is entirely self-managed with no automated failover, no managed patching, no automated backups.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for SQL Server or Aurora PostgreSQL. Use AWS DMS for data migration.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration: No orchestration for document lifecycle operations
findings.description: No workflow orchestration exists. Multi-step operations are entirely inline with no orchestration, error handling, or retry logic.
findings.gap: All operational logic is hardcoded inline with no structure for error recovery or retry.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, implement document upload workflows using Step Functions or application-level workflow patterns.

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming: No messaging infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure exists. All operations are tightly coupled and synchronous with no event emission capability.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes should be communicable to other services.
findings.recommendation: Implement event publishing (SNS/EventBridge) for document lifecycle events.

findings.title: Network Security: No network security configuration
findings.description: No network security configuration exists in the repository. Application runs HTTP only with no HTTPS, no VPC definitions, no security groups.
findings.gap: No evidence of VPC, private subnets, security groups, or network segmentation. No TLS/HTTPS.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in a VPC with private subnets and security groups. Enable HTTPS via ALB or API Gateway.

findings.title: API Entry Point: No gateway or load balancer
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, or CloudFront. The ColdFusion application is exposed directly through IIS.
findings.gap: Direct service exposure with no gateway or load balancer.
findings.recommendation: Place an API Gateway or ALB in front of the application.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling: No auto-scaling — single static instance
findings.description: No auto-scaling configured. Single EC2 instance with static capacity.
findings.gap: All capacity statically provisioned on a single instance.
findings.recommendation: Deploy on auto-scaling infrastructure (ECS with service auto-scaling, or Lambda).

findings.title: Backup and Recovery: No backups — disk loss equals data loss
findings.description: No backup configuration. README states 'disk loss = data loss' and 'no backups offsite.'
findings.gap: No automated backups for either the database or file storage. Complete data loss risk.
findings.recommendation: Migrate files to S3 (with versioning) and database to RDS (with automated backups and PITR).

findings.title: High Availability: Single instance, single AZ, no failover
findings.description: All resources in a single EC2 instance. No multi-AZ, no load balancing, no failover.
findings.gap: Single point of failure. Any instance or AZ failure results in complete outage.
findings.recommendation: Deploy compute across multiple AZs. Use RDS Multi-AZ. Store files in S3.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage: No IaC — 100% manual (ClickOps)
findings.description: No Infrastructure as Code exists. All infrastructure manually created.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage. Infrastructure is not reproducible, not version-controlled.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in Terraform or CDK.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation: No CI/CD — manual file copy deployment
findings.description: No CI/CD automation. Deployment by copying files over network share.
findings.gap: All deployments manual. No build, test, or deploy automation.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated build, test, security scan, and deploy stages.

findings.title: Programming Languages: CFML (ColdFusion 8) — no AWS SDK, no cloud-native tooling
findings.description: Application written in CFML targeting ColdFusion 8 (2007, EOL). No AWS SDK, no cloud-native tooling, multiple critical CVEs.
findings.gap: Language with no AWS SDK and no cloud-native tooling. Runtime is unsupported.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite in Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or Java 17+ with first-class AWS SDK support.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices: Tightly-coupled monolith with no module boundaries
findings.description: 2 CFML files with inline SQL, shared session state, shared datasource, no separation of concerns.
findings.gap: No module boundaries, pervasive shared state, no separation of concerns.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite with clear module boundaries using Hexagonal Architecture.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication: All communication synchronous
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. No async patterns exist.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous HTTP with no async patterns.
findings.recommendation: Implement async event publishing for document lifecycle events using SNS or EventBridge.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling: All operations synchronous regardless of duration
findings.description: All operations are synchronous regardless of duration. No background processing.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous. No async job infrastructure for long-running operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement async patterns for file upload processing using SQS + Lambda or Step Functions.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy: No API versioning
findings.description: No API versioning. Direct .cfm file URLs with no versioning scheme.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-path versioning through API Gateway.

findings.title: Service Discovery: All endpoints hard-coded
findings.description: All endpoints and configuration hard-coded. Datasource in CF Admin, file path hardcoded.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hard-coded in application code.
findings.recommendation: Externalize configuration via environment variables or AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage: Files on local disk with no object storage
findings.description: Documents stored on local file system at D:\docroot\files. No S3, no object storage, no parsing.
findings.gap: Data on local file system with no accessibility, no durability guarantees, no parsing.
findings.recommendation: Migrate all documents to Amazon S3. Implement parsing pipeline with Textract.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer: Queries scattered in CFML files with no DAL
findings.description: Database queries scattered directly in CFML files. No repository pattern, no DAO, no ORM.
findings.gap: Database imports and queries scattered with no pattern. SQL built by string concatenation.
findings.recommendation: Implement a repository/service layer pattern with parameterized queries.

findings.title: Database Engine Version and EOL: SQL Server 2005 — over 10 years past EOL
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 reached EOL April 2016. No security patches, no vendor support.
findings.gap: Database engine over 10 years past EOL with known critical vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Aurora PostgreSQL or RDS SQL Server (latest supported version). Use AWS DMS.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest: No encryption on any data surface
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Files on unencrypted local disk. SQL Server 2005 has no TDE.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest on any data store.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to S3 (SSE-KMS) for files and RDS/Aurora (KMS encryption) for database.

findings.title: API Authentication: Session-based auth without token-based (OAuth2/JWT)
findings.description: ColdFusion session-based authentication. No OAuth2, no JWT, no token rotation.
findings.gap: No token-based authentication. Session fixation possible.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2/JWT authentication via Amazon Cognito.

findings.title: Centralized Identity Integration: No external IdP, application-managed auth
findings.description: Application manages its own authentication entirely. No SSO, no external IdP.
findings.gap: No centralized IdP integration. No SSO. No federation.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito. Enable SSO federation with corporate directory.

findings.title: Secrets Management: Plaintext credentials in repository
findings.description: README documents CF Admin password as 'cfadmin'. Plaintext credential in version control.
findings.gap: Plaintext credential in repository. No secrets management. No rotation.
findings.recommendation: Store all secrets in AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching: Entire stack is EOL with no patching
findings.description: No patching strategy. All components EOL: Windows Server 2008, ColdFusion 8, IIS 7.
findings.gap: No patching strategy. All components past EOL with known critical vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Replace entire stack. Deploy on managed compute (Fargate/Lambda) to eliminate OS patching.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline: No security scanning — known vulnerabilities undetected
findings.description: No security scanning tools. No CI/CD pipeline to integrate them into. Known SQL injection vulnerabilities.
findings.gap: No security scanning. Known vulnerabilities in codebase with no detection.
findings.recommendation: Include SAST, dependency scanning, and container scanning in CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing: No tracing instrumented
findings.description: No distributed tracing. No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing. No ability to trace requests or diagnose issues.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry when rewriting.

findings.title: SLO Definitions: No SLOs, no monitoring
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No monitoring artifacts. No CloudWatch alarms.
findings.gap: No SLOs, no monitoring, no alerting.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for availability and latency. Implement CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: Business Metrics: No custom metrics published
findings.description: No business metrics. No custom CloudWatch metrics. No dashboards.
findings.gap: No business metrics. No visibility into value delivery.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom metrics for document uploads, downloads, search queries.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting: No alerting configured
findings.description: No alerting. No anomaly detection. Failures discovered only when users report them.
findings.gap: No alerting of any kind. No proactive failure notification.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms and anomaly detection. Integrate with incident management.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy: Direct-to-production file copy
findings.description: Direct-to-production deployment by copying files over network share. No staged rollout.
findings.gap: No staged rollout, no health checks, no rollback capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green or canary deployments using CodeDeploy.

findings.title: Integration Testing: No automated tests of any kind
findings.description: No unit tests, no integration tests, no end-to-end tests. No test framework.
findings.gap: No automated tests. Any change carries unvalidated regression risk.
findings.recommendation: Implement integration tests for critical workflows. Run in CI pipeline.

findings.title: Incident Response Automation: No runbooks, no automation
findings.description: No runbooks, no incident response automation. Recovery is entirely manual.
findings.gap: No incident response automation. Recovery from failures is manual and ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks. Implement self-healing with ECS task restart or Lambda retry.

findings.title: Observability Ownership: No observability infrastructure to own
findings.description: No observability ownership. No dashboards, no alarms, no team attribution.
findings.gap: No observability ownership. Monitoring is entirely absent.
findings.recommendation: Establish observability ownership with per-service dashboards and alarms.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — No stored procedures or proprietary SQL. All business logic in application layer. Standard ANSI SQL used.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Audit logging (CloudTrail) is an AWS account-level service. This repo has no IaC at all. CloudTrail evaluation belongs in the foundation infrastructure repo.
